videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants a summary of a YouTube video transcript in Korean, around 500 characters, with 3-5 sentences capturing the key points.
Key points from the transcript:
1. Election is over but controversy over Central Election Management Commission (선관위) trust is growing
2. Unprecedented shortage of ballot papers (투표용지 부족) occurred despite securing 110% budget for all voters
3. 14 polling stations in Seoul (Songpa, Gangnam, Gwangjin) ran out of ballots, some voters gave up, voting continued during vote counting in some places
4. Only printed 50-55% of ballots relative to voters (following guideline of minimum 50%), but secured 110% budget
5. Controversy over discrepancy between budget secured (110%) and actual printing (50%)
6. Structural problems: only 1 out of 9 commissioners is full-time, weak organizational management and supervision
7. Constitutional independent body with insufficient external oversight
I need to summarize this in 3-5 sentences, around 500 characters, in Korean only.
